desc: 冷月白格栅光茶室，桌面嵌盘可待客，桌下栅格柜体收纳
leaf: 新中式茶桌茶台（桌面嵌茶盘＋桌下栅格柜体与开放式层架，配矮凳）
name: 青瓷光嵌盘实木茶桌矮凳款

shots.intent: 首屏用冷调月白石墙加格栅斜射光影立住「新中式待客茶桌」的风格认领，一眼和满屏暖色红木茶台拉开距离。
shots.textZone: 左上石墙留白：横排细字主标「{selling_point_1}」浅灰衬底无衬线大字，其下一枚 1px 青瓷细线分隔线，再下两枚小号细字标签「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」

shots.intent: 干净冷调影棚单品图把桌面嵌盘、桌下栅格柜体与两端开放层架一次看清，负责搜索流量的一眼点击。
同机位俯视分屏放大「普通桌子配外置茶盘又占高又容易溢水」的真实痛点，用桌面一体嵌盘把顾虑对冲掉。
shots.textZone: 顶部通栏 #37423F 色带一行细字主标「{selling_point_2}」，其下一条 1px 青瓷细线，两格底角各一枚细线编号芯片「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」

shots.intent: 同墙同光同框三种摆法对比，让买家按自家开间自己判断这张桌能不能既喝茶又办公又吃饭，一次解决用途焦虑。
shots.textZone: 顶部主标「{selling_point_3}」，三格底角各一枚细线编号芯片「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」

shots.intent: 贴矮凳高度的斜仰实景把这张茶桌放回可坐可倒茶的生活现场，用真实茶器与地毯给出人体尺度，让买家代入自家客厅。
shots.textZone: 左下角一枚细字标签「{callout_1}」，不加其它文字

shots.intent: 正上方俯拍把桌面一体嵌盘的沉台边线、盘内茶器尺度与桌面纹理走向看清，回答「值不值这个价」。
shots.textZone: 上方留白带：细字小标题「{selling_point_4}」与其下一枚细字标签「{callout_1}」，1px 青瓷引线指向沉台内边

shots.intent: 正侧面平视把桌下栅格柜体、两端开放层架与落地框架的结构关系做实，证明收纳是这张桌的真的功能而不是贴图。
shots.textZone: 右侧留白带：小标题「{selling_point_5}」与其下两枚细字标签「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」，1px 青瓷引线指向层架口

shots.intent: 一屏排开实际可选的桌面处理与配套座位组合，让买家先把选型这一犹豫解决掉，替代源页那两个空白占位色块。
shots.textZone: 每个变体底缘一枚短标签「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」，同一条对齐基线，其上一行青瓷小标「{selling_point_6}」

shots.intent: 用三枚细线图标加一张通用参数表把「看什么、含什么」摊开，用透明结构替代源页那四行空白参数。
shots.textZone: 顶部主标「{selling_point_7}」；三枚细线圆盘各配一枚细字标签「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」；下方四行通用参数表行名为产品名称／规格尺寸／表面色调／包装方式，数值一律为占位符「{callout_4}」

shots.intent: 复用首屏机位的冷调格栅光收口，把整页情绪落回可待客可独处的茶室，再给一个明确的咨询动作。
shots.textZone: 下方三分之一松烟青墨色块：主标「{selling_point_1}」，其下一枚直角描边按钮，1px 青瓷细线 #7E9C93 描边，内一行行动文案「{callout_1}」

style.backgroundSystem: only three fields are allowed across the set: a real cool-toned new-Chinese tea room with a pale limestone wall #EDEFEA over a poured micro-cement floor #C9CCC7, one vertical timber-slat screen (格栅 partition) standing flat against the far wall as the shadow-casting element and a woven seagrass mat laid under the seating zone; a seamless cool moonstone studio sweep #EDEFEA blending into a pale micro-cement floor band #C9CCC7 for packshots, anatomy and spec screens; and one flat deep slate-green field #37423F carrying a single hairline celadon #7E9C93 rule for process and closing layouts. Images run full-bleed with no border at all: no corner brackets, no seal marks, no rounded cards; one clean copy zone per screen, never busy decor; the slat screen is scenery only and is never carried, tilted or leaned on
style.direction: new-Chinese tea-reception commerce rendered as a cool moonlit veranda tea studio — celadon-and-limestone daylight graphic editorial, deliberately NOT the warm ink-and-rice-paper with a vermilion seal look and NOT a nordic airy white room
style.iconSystem: 1px celadon #7E9C93 monoline pictograms inside thin hairline circles for the three-point feature row, plus small right-angle number chips drawn as 1px celadon outlines on #EDEFEA with a light-sans numeral, plus one full-width hairline rule as the only divider; no solid filled discs, no arrow-flag tags, no corner brackets, no seal circles, no gradient badges, no filled pill labels
style.lightingSystem: cool daylight grade: a 5000-5200K key entering high from an off-frame window at camera RIGHT at roughly a 45-degree elevation, so the slat screen throws parallel linear shadow bars across the floor and the near edge of the tabletop, plus a broad neutral sky bounce on the camera-left shadow side keeping the under-top shelf wings readable; one soft grounded contact shadow directly under each leg frame, a satin sheen running only along the moulded top rim and the glazed teaware, no warm lamp cast anywhere; this is deliberately NOT a warm 3000-3200K lace-raked window key and NOT a flat neutral 4200K downlight wash
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent new-Chinese tea-reception visual system across the entire image set, staged as a cool moonlit veranda tea studio rather than a warm ink-and-rice-paper room; fixed palette of moonstone limestone #EDEFEA, deep slate-green #37423F and celadon accent #7E9C93 with dark text #23302C, product tones taken unchanged from the reference tawny amber-brown top #96602F and espresso slats #46281A; cool temperature throughout; one modern light geometric sans family only, wide-tracked hairline Chinese display, all Chinese copy wrapped in 「」 and kept short, no serif and no brush calligraphy and no seal mark; backgrounds limited to a real cool-toned tea room with a pale limestone wall #EDEFEA over a poured micro-cement floor #C9CCC7 with one vertical timber-slat screen against the far wall casting the shadow pattern and a woven seagrass mat under the seating zone, a seamless cool moonstone studio sweep #EDEFEA into a pale micro-cement band #C9CCC7 for packshots and spec screens, and one flat slate-green field #37423F with a single hairline celadon rule for process and closing layouts, images full-bleed with no border, no corner brackets and no rounded cards, one clean copy zone per screen; lighting always a 5000-5200K key entering high from an off-frame window at camera right at about 45 degrees so the slat screen throws parallel shadow bars across floor and tabletop, broad neutral sky bounce on the camera-left shadow side, one soft grounded contact shadow under every leg, satin sheen only along the moulded top rim and the glazed teaware, never a warm 3000-3200K lace-raked key and never a flat neutral downlight wash; surface system of real solid timber with grain running along the board length and a satin finish, darker espresso #46281A vertical slats with near-black #2A1A12 falloff in the gaps, a level sunken tray well with a crisp inner edge, matte burnt-orange woven pads #D2701E with thin dark piping if supplied, pale micro-cement floor, natural seagrass mat #B7AE99 and celadon-glazed teaware #9FB6AE; icon system of 1px celadon monoline pictograms in hairline circles, right-angle hairline number chips and one full-width hairline rule, no filled discs, no arrow flags, no corner brackets, no seals; product presentation rules: identical scale and identical top, rim, tray-well position, under-top slatted cabinet, open slatted shelf wings, square leg section and low floor frame in every frame, stools or chairs only if actually supplied and then at their exact count, standing on the floor with real contact shadows, corrected straight verticals, a real furnishing as scale anchor, the slight 3/4 camera-right key angle reused across scene screens; no color palette changes, no warm grade, no vermilion, no mixed fonts, no corner brackets, no recoloured or plastic-laminate top, no restyled or re-proportioned product, no added drawers doors casters or carved panels, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no invented timber species, grade, lacquer, joinery or carving claims, no dimensions, load ratings, eco grades or certificates, no brand marks, no QR codes, no membership badges, no prices, no faces.
noDrift: no warm 3000-3200K interior grade, no lace-curtain shadow rakes, no amber lamp cast and no vermilion anywhere in this set
no mixed fonts: never replace the light geometric sans with a Ming serif, a brush script or a heavy bold grotesque
no corner brackets, no seal circles, no arrow-flag tags, no solid icon discs, no rounded cards
no recoloured, re-toned or plastic-laminate tabletop; grain must run along the board length as supplied
no invented timber species, wood or board grade, lacquer or finish type, joinery claim, hand-carving claim, formaldehyde number, eco grade, dimension, load rating, weight capacity or warranty claim

no restyled product: the recessed tray well, the under-top slatted cabinet, the open shelf wings, the square legs and the low floor frame stay exactly as supplied; no added drawer fronts, doors, casters, metal legs or carved panels
no random backgrounds and no inconsistent lighting direction; all shadow bars must come from the same high camera-right window source
no people's faces: any figure must be anonymous and cropped above the shoulders with hands still and unbranded clothing, and never a child climbing, sitting on or hanging from the table or a stool
never depict the slat screen being carried, tilted, held or leaned on, and never show anyone hanging objects on it
no brand mark, no shop name, no QR code, no membership or free-gift corner badge, no price, no discount, no coupon, no contact details
no invented certifications, test reports, awards, patents, sales counts, ratings or percentage comparison curves

style.presentationRules: the tea table keeps one proportional scale and one identity in every frame: the same rectangular top with its slightly raised moulded rim, the same single recessed rectangular tray well in the top and where it sits, the same solid cabinet block hung under the top with its run of narrow vertical slats, the same open slatted shelf wings at each end, the same four straight square-section legs joined by the low floor-level frame, the same grain direction and the same tawny-and-espresso two-tone reading; accompanying stools or chairs appear only if they exist in the reference and then keep their exact count and slatted leg form; the table always stands on the floor with real contact shadows under every leg and never floats; interior verticals, wall corners, the slat screen and the mat edge stay straight and corrected; a real furnishing (woven mat, teapot and cups, side stool, floor lamp base) always anchors human scale; the slight 3/4 camera-right key of the opening screen is reused on the closing screen so the set reads as one room
style.surfaceSystem: the tabletop renders as real solid timber exactly as supplied at a tawny amber-brown #96602F with visible grain running along the board length and a satin rather than mirror finish; the under-top cabinet front, the vertical slats and the shelf wings read darker at espresso #46281A with near-black #2A1A12 falloff in the slat gaps; the recessed tray well is a level sunken rectangle with a crisp inner edge, never a loose metal insert; any accompanying pad stays a matte burnt-orange woven surface #D2701E with a thin dark piping edge, never gloss vinyl; pale micro-cement floor #C9CCC7 with a faint trowel texture, a natural woven seagrass mat #B7AE99, celadon-glazed teaware #9FB6AE and one speckled stoneware vase — no marble, no glossy laminate, no plastic sheen
style.typography: one modern light geometric sans family only, Chinese display set at 100-250 weight with wide tracking around 0.35em in #23302C on pale fields and #EDEFEA on slate fields, never a high-contrast Ming serif and never brush calligraphy; numerals and small labels share the same light sans at a hairline weight; Chinese in-image copy always wrapped in 「」 and kept short, headline 26-40pt, kicker 12-14pt, labels 10-13pt, per-screen text budget under 50 characters; no seal, no stamp, no flourish over the first glyph
